visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain frames, including the 1024×640 summary. Individual Lausanne retains the long tiled nave and flying buttresses, cruciform transept with south rose/three lower lights, steep painted-porch roof, rounded choir/ambulatory and small eastern roof towers. The massive west beffroi has a blank stepped shaft, two open arcaded stages, red cap and corner pinnacles; the taller crossing spire has slate faces/pale arrises, lower pointed lights and an open gabled crown. West glazed/wood entrance and lower northwest range are retained. Corrected a choir roof/window collision and incomplete inner belfry cuts; added restrained rose petals, crown arches and lower ambulatory windows. Fine carving and exact roof profiles remain simplified.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared/geographic frames. Six existing shared 256-square continuous limestone, sandstone, ceramic tile, slate, wood and painted metal graphs serve seven groups including local blue-grey glass. Linear tints, metric UVs and flat architectural normals; no embedded images, facade photographs, bespoke textures or baked lighting. Graphs read once and unload leaves zero live model geometries. Geographic renders use flat terrain; source-terrain renders retain the standard viewer DEM.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final medium-fi frames: Economy/High, noon/late, street/block/skyline distances, texture-free silhouette, six details, four matched whole levels and four transitions. Skyline 963 triangles retains the long cruciform church, rounded choir, south rose/porch markers, west red-cap beffroi and tall slate crossing spire. District 3932 adds shared surfaces, recessed clerestory/choir lights, coarse rose spokes, portal bands, flying buttresses, gabled crown and two open bell stages with one coarse arch per face. Street 8385 adds aisle/ambulatory/tower lights, more belfry arches, mullions, rose petals and crown arches. Close-up/master 10236 retain finer arch/curve sampling and sparse portal figure/pinnacle abstractions. Swiss chalets are synthetic style fixtures. Physical phone/laptop timing remains pending.
